SUPERSEDES: implicit V1 term naming inside position_state
PURPOSE: Every EV term declares UNIT, SIGN, CONDITIONING, TIME_HORIZON, SOURCE and UNCERTAINTY, so that conditioning is a machine-checkable property rather than a convention held in someone's head.
THE_RULE: A term CONDITIONAL_ON_FILL lives INSIDE the fill branch and is never multiplied by P_FILL a second time.
A term that is already UNCONDITIONAL already contains its own P_FILL factor, lives OUTSIDE the branch, and is never multiplied by P_FILL at all.
A term that is CERTAIN belongs to an action that executes now; there is no fill branch and no P_FILL anywhere.
The same ECONOMIC_QUANTITY may appear in one sum ONCE, in ONE of those forms.
